simple.meaning: שִׁלּוּם (shillûwm) is a Hebrew word meaning “a requital , i.e. (secure) retribution , (venal) a fee.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שִׁלּוּם (H7966) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 34:8, with occurrences in Isaiah, Hosea, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁלּוּם (H7966) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שִׁלּוּם (H7966) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שִׁלּוּם (shillûwm) / H7966 is traced through Isaiah 34:8, Hosea 9:7, Micah 7:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a requital , i.e. (secure) retribution , (venal) a fee
definitions.full: H7966. shillum שִׁלּוּם Micah 7:3 , שִׁלֻּם Hosea 9:7 , noun [masculine] requital ; — plural שִׁלּוּמִים Isa 34:8 ; — 1 requital, retribution , הַשׁ ׳יְמֵי Hosea 9:7 (|| מְּקֻדָּה ); שׁ ׳שְׁנַת Isa 34:8 (|| נָקָם ). 2 reward, bride Micah 7:3 בַּשׁ ׳שֹׁפֵמ .

occurrences.englishText: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance,
The days of visitation have come.
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently.
